svg.title: Variable window: longest subarray of [2, 3, 1, 2, 4, 3] with sum at most 7
svg.desc: State after the shrink loop at each r. Blue is the window, red is what the shrink loop dropped at that step, grey is outside. Answer 3
svg.text: longest subarray with sum ≤ 7, after the shrink loop at each r
